hints.title: Peak Localization and Split Search
hints.text: The mountain array is strictly increasing up to a peak and strictly decreasing thereafter.

hints.title: Three Binary Searches Structure
hints.text: Locate the peak index using binary search on slope direction, then binary search the ascending and descending sides.

hints.title: Binary Partitioning Blueprint
hints.text: Find peak where arr.get(m) > arr.get(m+1). Search left half [0, peak] for target. If missing, search right half [peak+1, n-1] inverted.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Three sequential binary searches take at most 3 * log2(10000) <= 45 calls to get().
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Linear scanning exceeds the strictly enforced limit of 100 get() API calls.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Caching intermediate get calls is optional since 3 * log N is well within the 100-call constraint.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Finding peak index first, then searching the ascending prefix followed by descending suffix.
